title: WATCH: Vice Ganda, ‘Showtime’ hosts join GMA Christmas Station ID for first time

blocks.text: The hosts of ABS-CBN’s noontime show “It’s Showtime” are among the special guests featured in GMA Network’s 2026 Christmas Station ID, marking their first appearance in the Kapuso network’s annual holiday presentation. Led by Vice Ganda, the “It’s Showtime” family members seen in the Christmas Station ID include Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, Ogie Alcasid, Amy Perez, Teddy Corpuz, Ryan Bang, Darren Espanto, and Jackie Gonzaga. Titled “Liwanag Natin Ang Isa’t Isa,” the Christmas Station ID was released on Monday, Nov. 9 and carries a message of light, love, hope, and unity.
